objective: Implement the approved Relic full-system plan without weakening its acceptance gates

delivery.imaging: nonbootable data volumes and partitions on disposable media
delivery.remote_authority: milestone commits and pushes to implementation branch only

host_memory.linux_enforcement: systemd-run user transient service with MemoryMax=2G MemorySwapMax=0 TasksMax=128 CPUQuota=200%

tasks.name: Baseline and environments
acceptance: Preserve initial source and specification fingerprint
MIT license and pinned local toolchain
Native runner inventory and bounded CI authority

tasks.name: Contracts and feasibility
acceptance: Executable schemas and all five digest vectors
Independent encrypted backup/restore on each claimed native target
Measured archive index/resource and publication boundaries

tasks.name: Domain, state, and planning
acceptance: Typed identities and immutable payload bindings
Distinct attempt, destination, and occurrence lifecycles
Durable migration, revision conflicts, intents and receipts

tasks.name: Standalone backup and recovery
acceptance: Local and S3 encrypted archive with metadata reports
Selective and full restore with traversal defenses
Offline clean-environment independent recovery

tasks.name: Daemon, scheduler, and resource control
acceptance: Authenticated local API and CLI
Restart, DST, retry and cancellation correctness
Finite memory, descriptors, streams and spool under fan-out

tasks.name: Protection, maintenance, and replication
acceptance: Per-destination RPO/RTO and verification freshness
Guarded retention and last-good protection
Independent-key replica verified without source access

tasks.name: Copy, mirror, synchronization, and continuous operation
acceptance: Safe ordinary-file copies and guarded mirror deletions
Conflict-preserving synchronization and tombstone horizon
Watcher overflow and periodic reconciliation

tasks.name: Native source consistency
acceptance: VSS, APFS, and Btrfs native view capture
Helper ownership and crash cleanup
Exact achieved consistency and metadata-loss reports

tasks.name: Peer cluster and fenced execution
acceptance: Authenticated enrollment, QUIC, and consensus membership
Scoped destination gateway admission and receiver fencing
One/two/three voter fault and uncertainty acceptance

tasks.name: Desktop application
acceptance: Native three-tab tray UI independent of daemon
Inspect plans, restores, health and per-target outcomes
Theme, keyboard, screen reader, 200-percent text and resource evidence

tasks.name: Database and image adapters
acceptance: SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL usable-state restore
Nonbootable volume/partition image on disposable media
Wrong-device and complete recovery-set protection

tasks.name: Security, performance, and sustained acceptance
acceptance: Complete native recovery and adversarial corpus
Bounded fuzz and standalone/cluster soaks
Cold/warm resource and incremental-detection performance gates

tasks.name: Native packaging and final qualification
acceptance: Three native installer lifecycle and recovery tests
SBOM, MIT/dependency notices and artifact/source linkage
All required conformance evidence passes with no waivers
